needs.advanced: Readiness and interest for greater challenge

adhd.name: ADHD (documented in scenario)
adhd.question: Which attention, planning, or task-access needs are actually documented, and which supports does the learner find useful? ADHD alone does not establish a reading or mathematics need.

autism.name: Autism (documented in scenario)
autism.question: Ask about communication, sensory access, predictability, interests, and preferred participation. Do not assume low ability, poor motivation, or the same support needs for every autistic learner.

sld_reading.name: Specific learning disability: reading
sld_reading.question: Confirm the reading component involved and review the existing specialist assessment. A reading disability does not establish difficulty in mathematics or limit advanced content access.

sld_math.name: Specific learning disability: mathematics
sld_math.question: Confirm the mathematics difficulty and existing specialist supports. General problem-solving guidance is not evidence of a dyscalculia-specific treatment effect.

P1.name: P1 · Distressed
P1.question: Explore school well-being, belonging, and context with the learner. The profile is not a clinical diagnosis; address identified concerns alongside appropriate intellectual challenge.

P2.name: P2 · Disengaged
P2.question: Explore relevance, challenge, access barriers, and learner goals before choosing support. Low reported motivation is not evidence of low capacity or school dropout risk.

P3.name: P3 · Typical
P3.question: Ask about current strengths and unmet needs; a typical group pattern does not rule out disability, advanced readiness, or a need for support.

unknown.name: Unassigned / uncertain
unknown.question: No profile assignment is needed to review a documented learning goal. Establish context before interpreting any profile.

evidence_records.title: Build engagement in reading
evidence_records.subject: literacy
evidence_records.implementation: Review the guide with the teacher; plan meaningful reading choices and engagement supports without lowering text challenge.
evidence_records.monitor: Reading engagement alongside an appropriate reading outcome.
evidence_records.limitations: Evidence concerns literacy; it does not establish treatment of general distress or ADHD.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Make mathematical thinking visible
evidence_records.subject: math
evidence_records.implementation: Teach monitoring and reflection during problem solving; preserve the complexity of appropriately challenging problems.
evidence_records.monitor: Independent explanations, error checking, and transfer to new problems.
evidence_records.limitations: General instructional evidence; no established P1/P2 or diagnosis-specific effect.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Compare mathematical strategies
evidence_records.subject: math
evidence_records.implementation: Plan teacher-guided comparison of approaches to the same problem.
evidence_records.monitor: Flexible strategy use and explanations on new problems.
evidence_records.limitations: This is a guide recommendation, not an evaluated AchieveGo-generated lesson.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Review attendance and progress indicators
evidence_records.subject: any
evidence_records.outcome: Identifying and responding to risk of dropout
evidence_records.implementation: Agree who reviews attendance, behavior, and academic indicators and how concerns trigger coordinated support.
evidence_records.monitor: Attendance and progress, with an agreed review date.
evidence_records.limitations: Minimal is the source evidence level. Monitoring alone is not proof of improved completion; low motivation alone is not dropout risk.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Coordinate individualized school support
evidence_records.subject: any
evidence_records.population: Students identified as off track for graduation
evidence_records.implementation: School team reviews intensive individualized support described in the guide; confirm staffing and delivery requirements.
evidence_records.monitor: Attendance, course progress, and the learner’s experience of support.
evidence_records.limitations: Not a mental-health treatment recommendation or a validated profile-specific assignment.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Target the documented decoding difficulty
evidence_records.subject: literacy
evidence_records.population: Students requiring reading intervention in grades 4–9
evidence_records.implementation: A qualified educator reviews explicit instruction for decoding complex words; maintain access to advanced ideas through suitable supports.
evidence_records.monitor: Word reading and transfer to connected text.
evidence_records.limitations: A diagnostic label alone does not specify the decoding need or establish benefit for a gifted subgroup.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Teach a routine for understanding text
evidence_records.subject: literacy
evidence_records.population: Students requiring reading intervention in grades 4–9
evidence_records.implementation: Review the guide’s comprehension practices and select instruction informed by assessment.
evidence_records.monitor: Comprehension on new texts, with assistance conditions recorded.
evidence_records.limitations: The guide’s evidence level does not validate AI-created instructional materials.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Check & Connect · staying in school
evidence_records.locator: Dropout Prevention, protocol 3.0; Staying in School
evidence_records.grade_basis: Outcome-specific grades from the evidence snapshot
evidence_records.subject: any
evidence_records.population: High school students with learning, behavioral, or emotional disabilities in the reviewed evidence
evidence_records.implementation: A sustained program of mentoring, monitoring, and coordinated support. Confirm program training, staffing, and fidelity requirements; a brief check-in is not the studied program.
evidence_records.monitor: Track the stated outcome; keep graduation, school retention, and course progression distinct.
evidence_records.limitations: No validated effect for AchieveGo profiles, giftedness, or each diagnostic subgroup. Sample overlap requires team review. No discernible effects does not prove equivalence or benefit.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record
evidence_records.essa_basis: Outcome table on EvidenceSnapshot/78; a separate framework from effectiveness

evidence_records.title: Review an enrichment opportunity
evidence_records.locator: Research synthesis; program selection still required
evidence_records.grade_basis: Prototype browsing range 1–12; not verified coverage of every grade in the synthesis. Review program- and age-specific evidence before use
evidence_records.subject: any
evidence_records.rating: Positive pooled academic and socioemotional findings
evidence_records.population: Gifted students in varied enrichment programs
evidence_records.implementation: Identify a suitable enrichment opportunity with the learner and check readiness, access, and program evidence.
evidence_records.monitor: Domain growth, engagement, and learner-defined goals.
evidence_records.limitations: Synthesis-level evidence is not evidence for any specific local project or AI-generated enrichment. Applicability by age, diagnosis, and program requires review; not a treatment for distress.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record

evidence_records.title: Review subject acceleration
evidence_records.locator: Acceleration findings of the second-order meta-analysis
evidence_records.subject: any
evidence_records.population: K–12; acceleration evidence for advanced learners
evidence_records.implementation: A school team considers domain readiness, learner preference, and appropriate placement; this card does not authorize a placement change.
evidence_records.monitor: Domain mastery, transition experience, and sustained access to supports.
evidence_records.limitations: Readiness for enrichment does not establish readiness for acceleration. Effects depend on comparison group and implementation; no validated profile-by-diagnosis allocation rule.
evidence_records.exact_profile_diagnosis_effect: Not established in this curated record
